markdown: ## 문제 Query the list of CITY names ending with vowels (a, e, i, o, u) from STATION. Your result cannot contain duplicates. Input Format The STATION table is described as follows: ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/179eda9b-0fe1-803f-837c-fb3ad8db2cfe/18d9a3a7dd65531f.webp) where LAT_N is the northern latitude and LONG_W is the western longitude. ## 풀이 ```bash SELECT DISTINCT CITY FROM STATION WHERE LOWER(RIGHT(CITY, 1)) IN ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u'); ```
